data.narrative:
Quandela is a Series B quantum computing company founded by Valerian Giesz, Pascale Senellart, and Niccolo Somaschi, backed by PROQCIMA. The quantum computing sector comprises 11 known comparables: 3 public companies (IONQ, RGTI, QBTS) and 8 private firms including Quantinuum, IonQ, PsiQuantum, D-Wave Quantum, and SandboxAQ.

Standard peer-median valuation methodology is not applicable here. The quantum computing comparables universe lacks sufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage datapoints at Quandela's valuation tier—zero same-stage peers, zero adjacent-stage peers, and zero similar-tier peers were identified despite the 8-company private set. Applying an all-sector median would introduce material distortion given the wide variance in quantum computing company maturity, technology approach, and capital efficiency across stages.

Without sufficient narrow-band peer anchors, triangulation via comparable company analysis cannot be meaningfully executed at this time. A credible valuation would require either: expansion of the comparables set through deeper market discovery; application of venture-stage frameworks (revenue multiple analysis or venture capital method) if financial traction data exists; or a technology-risk-adjusted discounted cash flow if commercialization milestones are quantifiable. The sparsity of late-stage quantum computing exits limits backward-engineering from exit multiples. Further due diligence on Quandela's technical differentiation, customer pipeline, and capital efficiency relative to the named peer set would be necessary to establish a defensible valuation range.
